item.title: Marion police warn of phone scam impersonating federal agencies
item.description: MARION, Ill., (KBSI) — The Marion Police Department is warning Southern Illinois residents about a phone scam involving callers posing as federal officials. Police said the callers claim to represent the Social Security Administration and work with the U.S. Marshals Service.
